resource_rationale: Main reported a G1 9.70-second process failure, followed by three valid exact-case reruns at 4.45/4.95/4.60 seconds, and an all-valid canonical rerun with one wall time above 8 seconds. Prelaunch limits are therefore 12 seconds per case and 360 seconds per suite. Host/startup jitter is not hardness evidence. Quality targets remain 0.40/0.30 unchanged.
